We set up an appraisal mechanism to assess the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of data and information collected and reported, and include the performance appraisal results in the appraisal results of relevant departments and responsible persons who provide data. By promoting the ESG performance appraisal mechanism, we continue to promote the regular collection of data and improve the Group's ESG management mechanism, so as to provide strong support for the daily management of ESG.
